title: The Weekly meeting of the club
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：weekly　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 weekly 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the athlete wrote of ① a weekly meeting of the club in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② so weekly that nobody in the stadium would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the weekly ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the weekly meeting of the club that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too weekly to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the weekly ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a weekly paper of the town, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as weekly as the paper of the town they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was weekly or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something weekly, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite weekly; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the weekly ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, with great care, she wrote of another weekly meeting of the club in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less weekly than anybody had expected. ⑩ The weekly paper of the town that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the weekly ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 每周（前置定语 a weekly meeting of the club：1959 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件每周的周会）
B. adj. 每周／一周一次（两处加强说法：so weekly that … 与 no less weekly than …）
C. adj. 每周／一周一次（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 每周（表语 too weekly to do：母亲觉得它太每周，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 一周一次（前置定语 a weekly paper of the town：叔叔把整件事称作一桩一周一次的周报）
F. adj. 一周一次（同级比较 as weekly as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩镇上的周报相比）
G. adj. 一周一次（后置定语 something weekly：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 一周一次（受程度副词修饰 quite weekly：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a weekly meeting of the club
the weekly meeting of the club that
a weekly paper of the town
The weekly paper of the town that

answers.why: weekly 意为“每周”，1959 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件每周的周会”，此处作前置定语 a weekly meeting of the club。
weekly 意为“每周”，此处用 so weekly that 结构，说它每周到体育场里没人敢靠近。
weekly 意为“每周”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的每周俱乐部的周会，等于最高级的说法。
weekly 意为“每周”，母亲认为这件东西“太每周了，谁也用不上”，too weekly to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
weekly 意为“一周一次”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩一周一次的周报”，此处作前置定语 a weekly paper of the town。
weekly 意为“一周一次”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩镇上的周报一样一周一次”，同级比较用 as weekly as。
weekly 意为“一周一次”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“一周一次的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something weekly。
weekly 意为“一周一次”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当一周一次”，quite 修饰原级 weekly。
weekly 意为“一周一次”，no less weekly than 表示“其一周一次不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之一周一次不亚于任何人的预料。
weekly 意为“一周一次”，母亲 1971 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的一周一次周报”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件每周的周会。（a weekly meeting of the club）
它每周到体育场里没有一个人敢靠近。（so weekly that …）
母亲觉得它太每周，谁也用不上。（too weekly to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩一周一次的周报。（a weekly paper of the town）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩镇上的周报一样一周一次。（as weekly as …）
到了 1966 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件一周一次的东西。（something weekly）
answers: In 1959 the athlete wrote of a weekly meeting of the club in the programme.
It was so weekly that nobody in the stadium would go near it.
My mother thought it too weekly to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a weekly paper of the town.
He said nobody would call it as weekly as the paper of the town they had once had.
By 1966 the programme asked for nothing but something weekly.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 weekly 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the athlete wrote of a weekly meeting of the club in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the weekly meeting of the club that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too weekly to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a weekly paper of the town, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite weekly, and everybody laughed.
The weekly ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
